FISHING LICENCE · URUGUAY

Uruguay fishing licence

Uruguay generally allows sport fishing without a permit. Specific areas, species, dates or methods can require one, so check the exact water before your trip.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers in an activity or area subject to a specific permit rule.

Who doesn’t

  • The general sport-fishing rule in article 44 allows fishing freely, subject to regulated exceptions.

Rules visitors should know

  • Do not sell a recreational catch.
  • Do not export a recreational catch; the law limits export authorization to research agreements.
  • Do not buy or transfer another person's fishing permit.

How to buy

There is no general sport-fishing permit purchase under article 44. Contact DINARA for any specific authorization.
